clauses.Q8: Why some datasets are open and some are not open?
clauses.Q8A1: The goal is to release as many datasets as possible under the Open Government Licence. However, since the data comes from multiple sources, few datasets can't be shared publicly due to licensing restrictions and permissions from the data owners.
clauses.tc_Definitionsli1: "Open Data" Refers to geospatial data that is made available to the public, free of charge and without restrictions on its use, redistribution, or adaptation. Open Data is fully downloadable and can be utilized by users in accordance with these Terms and Conditions.
clauses.tc_accesstodatali1: Open Data: This category of data is publicly accessible and available for direct download. Users are permitted to download, use, and integrate Open Data within their own business operations, subject to these Terms and Conditions and any other accompanying licenses. When utilizing Open Data, users should credit the SDI Data Catalog as the source, unless indicated otherwise.

Your use of the SDI Data Catalog and its Content grants no rights to you in relation to any intellectual property rights belonging to DGE or to the use of any Content on the SDI Data Catalog.
